subject: Asphalt seep
topic: This black goo oozing out of the seafloor is natural asphalt.
script:
This black goo oozing out of the seafloor is natural asphalt.
NOAA filmed it in the Gulf of Mexico, more than a kilometer deep.
Deep below the seafloor here, there are reservoirs of oil and gas.
Some of it slowly leaks up through cracks, a little at a time.
The lighter parts escape, and the heavy, tar-like part is left behind.
Over time it can pile up and harden, a little like lava.
And amazingly, life moves in.
Microbes feed on the chemicals, and other animals feed on them, turning a tar pit into an oasis.
Would you have guessed asphalt forms naturally?
pkg_title: This Black Goo Is Natural ASPHALT From the Deep 🛢️ #Shorts
